description: Brazilian national water resources information system metadata catalogue (SNIRH) is an open data portal listed in Brazilian national water resources information system metadata catalogue (SNIRH), a metadata catalogue (CSW), published or maintained by Agência Nacional de Águas e Saneamento Básico (ANA, SNIRH). SNIRH metadata catalogue is the Brazilian national water resources information system metadata catalogue (SNIRH). This search read 199 of its metadata records; the ones whose titles name a transport, energy, water, communications or other infrastructure asset, network or facility, or a natural hazard, are catalogued as records of their own, and the rest (topographic map ... Coverage: Brasil. 199 datasets are listed in the catalogue that this harvest read; 19 of them are about infrastructure and became records of their own. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is set per dataset on the portal. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support finding infrastructure and hazard data of this country. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-csw-snirh-portal.
